annotations.title: Stop asking a modifier on a category

description: Stop asking a modifier in one category. The modifier itself survives and keeps working everywhere else — use delete_modifier to remove it entirely. Takes the LINK id from get_category_modifiers, not the modifier id. If the category inherits the same modifier from a parent, the till keeps asking it; unlink it from the parent instead.

categoryModifierId.description: Link id from get_category_modifiers — the link, NOT the modifier and NOT the category

name: hub_unlink_modifier_from_category
